name: etude
title: Etude
description: A music school theme in Urtext blue-grey card and deep navy ink where every page opens as a study-edition cover — the title in spaced capitals inside a double-rule frame, the subject beneath like ‘for violin’, the school’s name as the imprint — beside a timetable set like the edition’s contents page on ivory music paper.

tokens.--font-caps: the spaced capitals: page titles on the cover, the imprint, the site title, menu links, day names, sheet headings, section headings and instructor names in the list
tokens.--font-text: reading text, the 'for' line under a title, class times and names, and everything in italics
tokens.--text-xs: the imprint, menu links, the trial buttons, the Today word, the footer name and the printed site address
tokens.--text-s: the site title, day names, sheet and section headings, dates, tags, pagination and the footer
tokens.--text-m: base body size, class rows and instructor names in the list
tokens.--text-l: the 'for' line on the cover, the intro line on an instructor's page, and h3 headings
tokens.--text-title: the cover title in spaced capitals
tokens.--leading-caps: line height of spaced capitals and of the cover title
tokens.--tracking-title: letter spacing of the cover title
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the smaller spaced capitals (imprint, menu, day names, headings)
tokens.--color-bg: page background — the blue-grey cover card
tokens.--color-text: body text, titles, the site title and menu links — deep navy ink
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: levels, teacher names, dates, list summaries, the footer note, and the leader dots on the timetable
tokens.--color-accent: links and the underline under instructor names, the Today word, the hovered trial button, and the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--color-on-accent: text on the accent colour (the hovered buttons)
tokens.--color-frame: the cover's double-rule frame, the small rule and diamond on the cover, the rules beside day names, the current menu item's underline, button outlines and other ink rules
tokens.--color-paper: the ivory music-paper sheets that hold the timetable, the instructor list and page text; the photo mount and the skip link
tokens.--color-staff: the stave ruled across the top of each sheet, the sheet edge, code block edges, and the hairlines between classes, entries and table rows
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a line of reading text
tokens.--page-width: maximum width of the page (menu, cover and sheets together)
tokens.--cover-width: width of the upright cover beside the page on wide screens
tokens.--cover-min: the cover's least height on wide screens, so it stands as a portrait card
tokens.--time-col: width of the class-time column on the timetable (a longer time wraps; phones use a little over half of it, so a time range takes two lines)
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: between list items and between a name and the line under it
tokens.--space-2: small gap: row padding on the timetable and table cells
tokens.--space-3: base step: page gutter, gaps inside sheets
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks, sheet padding, and space inside the cover frame
tokens.--space-5: large gap: above the cover title, beside the upright cover, above the footer
tokens.--frame-outer: thickness of the heavy outer rule of the cover frame
tokens.--frame-inner: thickness of the thin inner rule of the cover frame
tokens.--frame-gap: distance between the two rules of the cover frame
tokens.--hairline: width of thin lines: stave lines, hairlines between rows, sheet edges, the outer rule of buttons
tokens.--tap-target: minimum touch height of menu links, buttons and pagination
tokens.--photo-ratio: instructor portrait shape as width divided by height (0.8 is a 4:5 portrait)
